fomod.Name: Civil War Final Battle Equipment
fomod.Author: ApocryphaRealm
fomod.Description: Two sets of war gear for the end of the Civil War - Ice Veins for the Stormcloaks, Dragon Blood for the Legion - issued by Ulfric Stormcloak or General Tullius in his own hall before the last army marches. Every piece is enchanted and every enchantment is named for the piece it sits on. Tempering only; the sets cannot be forged. Requires nothing but Skyrim Special Edition.
